description: A full set that drops the only home, anchored at seq 2 and issued 8 days before the entry at seq 3. With no home remaining it is due at its issued; the activate must be issued at max(due, previous) and no more than 7 days after due, so it is malformed. A full set's issued is bounded by its anchor's issued and by the 7-day bound, as in an account with no home.
